dct_description_sm: This is a line dataset of the locations where a wadi (dried river bed) intersects a key access road in Sudan. The line gives the length of which the road is impacted by the wadi. This information was produced to understand which roads maybe more affected during the rainy season, when wadis can fill with water quickly. The dataset was produced in collaboration with the WFP Global Logistics Cluster. Please find more about the project [here](https://www.zooniverse.org/projects/alicemead/sudan-road-access-logistics-cluster).
